Tap

A tap is the safety signal that tells your training partner to reset.

Tap to tell your partner to stop.

Move with control and communicate early while training tap.

7 Words You’ll Hear On Day One

These are the words that help a beginner feel safer, calmer, and less lost during a first class.

01

Tap

The safe way to reset.

 02

Guard

Use your legs to stay safe from bottom.

 03

Frame

Make space with strong body shape.

 04

Shrimp / Hip Escape

Move your hips away to make room.

 05

Mount

A top position beginners hear early.

 06

Side Control

A common top control position from the side.

 07

Control

The big idea behind safe Jiu-Jitsu.

Begin with these seven foundational words for your first class.
